cards.subject: New Stormwind
lines: The first city burned in the First War.
Everything you can see except Old Town is a replacement, built on credit, by men who were never paid.

cards.subject: The Valley of Heroes
cards.tag: The bridge you came in on
lines: Turalyon, Alleria, Khadgar, Kurdran, Danath. The expedition that went through the Dark Portal and did not come back.
The statues honour their sacrifice. The city is certain they are dead.
Every one of them is alive on the other side.

cards.subject: The Stonemasons' Guild
lines: They rebuilt the city out of ash — the Keep, the Cathedral, all of it, over years.
The House of Nobles had spent the treasury on the army and could not pay them.
When their guildmaster demanded the money, the nobles dissolved the guild. His name was Edwin VanCleef.

seed.body: Everything white in this city was built by the men who became the Defias. Nobody in here mentions it.

cards.subject: Queen Tiffin Wrynn
lines: The masons rioted when the guild was dissolved. The Queen came out to calm them.
Something thrown from the crowd killed her.
Anduin's mother. Varian never recovered, and everything after — the Defias, Westfall, the empty throne — runs from that afternoon.

cards.subject: Old Town
lines: The timber and the crooked streets are the original city. Everywhere else is the reconstruction.
It is dirtier and poorer on purpose.
The Alliance's intelligence service keeps its house here rather than in the Keep.

cards.subject: The Vault
lines: There is a second prison in the canal, ringed by water, gated, with two guards on it.
It has never opened. Not in alpha, not in beta, not since.
There is a clock on the roof and it has stopped.

cards.subject: The Stockade
lines: The door is a hole in the canal wall and the prison is directly under the city.
The guards have been driven out and the convicts are running it.
The man behind it is VanCleef's lieutenant, arrested at the riot that killed the Queen. The Defias reached into the capital's own jail.

cards.subject: The Slaughtered Lamb
lines: A shabby pub with a summoning circle in the cellar and three warlock trainers standing round it.
It is not hidden. It is an official training ground.
The name is borrowed from An American Werewolf in London.

cards.subject: The Park
cards.tag: The only district built for nothing
lines: Night elves sank a moonwell in the middle of it. Running water and grass inside a stone capital.
It is the only place on the continent a druid can train, and the only district with no purpose but sitting down.
It does not survive the expansion after this one. Go and stand in it.

seed.body: Sit in the Park for ten minutes some evening. It is the quietest ground in any capital and it gets deleted later.

cards.subject: There is no harbour
lines: The tram was cut under the sea so dwarves could reach the humans quickly. It is the only fast way out of this city.
To reach Kalimdor you ride to Ironforge and run the Wetlands to Menethil.
The docks that make all of this easy do not exist yet.

cards.subject: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
lines: The king vanished. The crown went to his son, who is a child, and Bolvar rules in his name.
He is a good man and the most thoroughly handled person in the building.
No adult king, a wrecked treasury, and a compromised council. That is the city in 1.12.

cards.subject: Lady Katrana Prestor
cards.tag: Stands to the right of the throne
lines: She advises the regent and she talks him out of sending troops to Lakeshire and Duskwood, which is why those zones are on their own.
She is Onyxia, and she is a black dragon, and she is standing there right now.
You can walk up and click on her.

cards.subject: The Great Masquerade
lines: Marshal Windsor walks from the front gates through the whole city to the throne room, with the guards calling out to him as he passes.
"The masquerade is over, Lady Prestor. Or should I call you by your true name... Onyxia..."
She kills him in front of the boy king and teleports out. Nothing about the room afterwards says it happened.
